C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero fractional part or converting a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n to align fraction parts.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly rewrites an operand before subtraction to make whole and fractional parts compatible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator for two proper fractions.
Do not tag when the step only subtracts already-aligned whole or fractional parts.
Do not tag when the step only combines final whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fractional parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when the solver converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are rewritten to matching denominators before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag when a whole number is rewritten as 0/n; that belongs to operand normalization.
Do not tag when the step only subtracts numerators after denominators are already aligned.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract whole-number parts once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver subtracts numerators of fractions that already share a denominator.
Tag when the solver subtracts whole parts of mixed numbers or whole-minus-whole components.
Tag when the solver performs direct subtraction of whole and fraction parts without borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the main work is creating a common denominator.
Do not tag when the step is specifically borrowing/regrouping because the fractional subtraction would be negative.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies or combines the final answer.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into denominator/denominator fractional units.
Tag when the solver adjusts both the whole part and the fractional part after a negative fractional difference appears.
Tag when regrouping is used in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is merely normalized before subtraction.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or rewrite a zero-valued fraction as 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver reduces a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when the solver simplifies 0/n to 0.
Tag when the step explicitly states simplification after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fraction is already in lowest terms and no simplification step is shown.
Do not tag when the step only performs subtraction.
Do not tag when the step only combines whole and fractional parts into a mixed number.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver explicitly combines separate whole and fractional results into one final number.
Tag when the solver concludes that a zero whole part should be omitted, yielding a proper fraction.
Tag when the solver combines a whole part with a zero fractional part to produce an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only subtracts components without assembling the final form.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies a fraction.
Do not tag when the final answer is already produced directly in a single subtraction step with no separate composition shown.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are different.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fraction parts.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number items if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator alignment with an explicitly chosen denominator.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as n + 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction to match the other operand.
Tag when the solver explicitly restructures the operands before subtraction rather than subtracting immediately.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary combination of whole and fractional results at the end.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion whose purpose is only to create a common denominator.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solver subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after setup is complete.
Tag same-denominator fraction subtraction even if it yields zero or a negative fractional result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag simplification such as reducing 9/12 to 3/4.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part to continue subtraction.
Tag when 1 whole is rewritten as d/d and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping changes a negative fractional difference into a positive proper fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d before any subtraction.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction cases where no regrouping is needed.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or rewrite a zero-valued fraction as 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor after subtraction.
Tag when a result like 0/3 is rewritten as 0.
Tag when simplification occurs before the final mixed-number or integer answer is stated.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction itself.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless an actual reduction or zero simplification is performed.
Do not tag normalization of the original operands.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one final number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a whole part is combined with a zero fraction to present an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fraction parts.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step explicitly assembles the final form.
Do not tag operand rewriting before subtraction.
